next.reason: 1985: 'Comment lines or blank lines appearing in library text are copied into the resultant source program unchanged'; 2023: 'If the line is a comment line or a blank line, that line is logically discarded. / shall not introduce ... a comment, or a blank line'. Both ignore comments in matching (2023 treats them as a space). 1985 copies comment/blank lines from library text and pseudo-text-2 into the result; 2023 discards them.
